stories.headline: Blackstone Files for ~$2B Data Center REIT IPO Targeting AI Hyperscaler Facilities

key_facts.fact: Blackstone filed for an IPO of Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust Inc. (ticker BXDC) on Friday, a new data-center acquisition vehicle that plans to buy already-built and leased properties.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone Inc. filed for an initial public offering of a new data-center acquisition vehicle that plans to buy already-built and leased properties benefiting from the artificial intelligence boom.

key_facts.fact: The vehicle will target newly built data centers valued at $250M to $1.5B each, leased to investment-grade hyperscalers, with expected yields of 5.75%–7%+ per year and automatic rent escalators of 2–3% annually.
key_facts.excerpt: The new vehicle will target newly built data centers valued at between $250 million and $1.5 billion and leased to investment-grade hyperscalers... The properties are expected to yield 5.75% to 7% a year, or more, and the rent would automatically rise by 2% to 3% annually.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported Blackstone plans to raise approximately $2 billion, with Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and Morgan Stanley as joint lead book-running managers.
key_facts.excerpt: The joint lead book-running managers include Goldman Sachs (GS), Citigroup (C), and Morgan Stanley (MS). Bloomberg News reported earlier that Blackstone was planning a $2B IPO for an acquisition company that will buy data centers.

key_facts.fact: The REIT is currently a 'blind pool' with no acquired assets yet. It will be externally managed by BX REIT, an affiliate of Blackstone, which manages $77B in infrastructure capital and $319B in real estate investor capital.
key_facts.excerpt: The company intends to qualify as a real estate investment trust but is currently considered a 'blind pool,' as it hasn't yet acquired any data center assets... The infrastructure group was founded in 2017 and manages $77B of capital across digital infrastructure, energy, and transportation assets.

key_facts.fact: Blackstone estimates the total addressable stabilized data center market at approximately $1 trillion over the next five years.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone estimates the industry represents a substantial investment opportunity with an estimated $1T total addressable stabilized data center market expected over the next five years.

stories.headline: Three OpenAI Stargate Infrastructure Leaders Leave to Join Meta

key_facts.fact: Peter Hoeschele, who played a critical role in OpenAI's Stargate initiative and led work on the Abilene, Texas data center site, is joining Meta along with Shamez Hemani (computing strategy and business development) and Anuj Saharan (computing organization leader).
key_facts.excerpt: Peter Hoeschele, who played a critical role in OpenAI's Stargate initiative, is one of the new hires... He'll be joined by Shamez Hemani, who worked on computing strategy and business development, and Anuj Saharan, another leader in the computing organization.

key_facts.fact: Meta CEO Zuckerberg has pledged up to $135 billion in capital expenditures for 2026 alone, focused on AI infrastructure, with plans to spend hundreds of billions more by the end of the decade.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta projected as much as $135 billion in capital expenditures, with a focus on AI infrastructure projects. Before the end of the decade, Zuckerberg has promised to spend hundreds of billions more on AI infrastructure projects.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI previously said it was grateful for the three employees' contributions and hired former Intel Corp. executive Sachin Katti in November to lead its industrial compute efforts.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI... previously said that the company was grateful for the contributions of the three employees and remains focused on hiring talent for its infrastructure plans. The company hired former Intel Corp. executive Sachin Katti in November to lead its industrial compute efforts.

key_facts.fact: Stargate was announced last year at the White House as a $500 billion venture between OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank. OpenAI also paused its Stargate UK project and decided not to lease an expansion to the Abilene, Texas site.
key_facts.excerpt: Stargate was announced last year at the White House as a $500 billion venture between OpenAI, Oracle Corp. and SoftBank Group Corp... OpenAI said Thursday that it's pausing its Stargate artificial intelligence infrastructure project in the UK... The company, along with Oracle, also decided not to lease an expansion to the site in Abilene.

stories.headline: CoreWeave Signs Multiyear Deal With Anthropic, Now Serves 9 of Top 10 AI Labs

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave announced a multiyear agreement with Anthropic to provide data center capacity using various Nvidia chip architectures at its US data centers for Claude AI model workloads.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave, a publicly traded AI cloud infrastructure company, announced on Friday a 'multi-year' agreement with AI developer Anthropic, which will use CoreWeave's cloud computing data centers for its Claude AI model workloads.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave now serves 9 of the 10 major developers of large language models, according to CEO Michael Intrator, with clients including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Meta.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave heeft daarmee nu de vier grootste AI-modelmakers als klanten: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google en Meta, aldus CEO Michael Intrator.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave shares surged more than 12% on Friday to $102.73 following the announcement.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of CoreWeave surged more than 12% on Friday and are trading at $102.73 at the time of writing.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave currently operates 43 active data centers and has contracted more than 3 gigawatts of server farm power capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: Het bedrijf beschikt over 43 actieve datacenters en heeft meer dan 3 gigawatt aan vermogen gecontracteerd voor zijn serverfarms.

key_facts.fact: The deal follows CoreWeave's recent $8.5 billion capital raise led by Meta and Meta's $21 billion compute commitment to CoreWeave.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement follows CoreWeave's recent $8.5 billion capital raise, led by tech giant Meta Platforms.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has pledged $50 billion for new AI data centers in the US and earlier this week partnered with Broadcom and Google to secure 3.5 GW of energy.
key_facts.excerpt: Eerder deze week sloot het een partnerschap met Broadcom en Google om 3,5 gigawatt aan energie te verkrijgen. Dat is genoeg om zo'n 2,6 miljoen Amerikaanse huishoudens gelijktijdig van stroom te voorzien.

stories.headline: Tesla FSD Supervised Gets First European Approval in the Netherlands

key_facts.fact: The Dutch vehicle authority RDW granted type approval for Tesla's FSD Supervised on April 10, making the Netherlands the first European market to authorize the system on public roads.
key_facts.excerpt: The RDW (Rijksdienst voor het Wegverkeer, the Dutch vehicle authority) issued a formal type approval for Tesla's driver assistance system, FSD Supervised, on April 10, 2026, making the Netherlands the first European market to authorize the software on public roads.

key_facts.fact: The approval followed more than 18 months of testing on both the RDW's own test track and Dutch public roads. FSD Supervised complies with UN R-171 standards and benefits from Article 39 exemptions under EU Regulation 2018/858.
key_facts.excerpt: The Dutch vehicle authority RDW granted the type approval after more than 18 months of rigorous testing on both closed tracks and public roads. FSD Supervised complies with UN R-171 standards and benefits from Article 39 exemptions under EU Regulation 2018/858.

key_facts.fact: The driver remains fully responsible and must maintain attention at all times; the RDW approved FSD as an advanced driver assistance system, not autonomous technology. Drivers don't need hands on the wheel but sensors monitor alertness.
key_facts.excerpt: The RDW approved FSD Supervised as an advanced driver assistance system, not autonomous or self-driving technology. Drivers are not required to keep hands on the steering wheel while the system is active, but they must remain alert and able to intervene at any moment.

key_facts.fact: About 100,000 Tesla Model 3 and Model Y vehicles in the Netherlands are eligible for the FSD software. Tesla is the most popular EV maker in the Netherlands.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla is the most popular maker of electric cars in the Netherlands, with around 100,000 Model 3 and Model Ys combined that would be eligible for FSD software.

key_facts.fact: The RDW will submit an application for EU-wide approval to the European Commission. All 27 member states will vote; Tesla anticipates possible EU-wide recognition during summer 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: RDW said it would also submit an application for the technology to be used throughout the EU... Tesla said last month it was anticipating possible EU-wide approval during the summer.

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk commented: 'First (supervised) FSD approval in Europe! Congratulations to the Tesla team and thank you to the regulatory authorities in the Netherlands for all the hard work required to make this happen.'
key_facts.excerpt: CEO Elon Musk also commented on the approval in a post on X, saying: 'First (supervised) FSD approval in Europe! Congratulations to the Tesla team and thank you to the regulatory authorities in the Netherlands for all the hard work required to make this happen.'

stories.headline: China's Zhiyuan Robot Spins Off Quadruped Unit, Targets ¥500M Revenue in 2026

key_facts.fact: Zhiyuan Robot (智元机器人, also known as Agibot) spun off its quadruped robot business into a new independent subsidiary called Zhiyuan Kutuo (智元酷拓).
key_facts.excerpt: 智元机器人近期对其业务版图做出重要调整，分拆旗下四足机器人业务，成立了独立子公司智元酷拓。

key_facts.fact: Zhiyuan Kutuo targets ¥500M in revenue for 2026. By 2030, the company plans to ship 300,000 units per year and reach ¥10B in annual revenue, with overseas revenue exceeding 35%.
key_facts.excerpt: 智元酷拓2026年目标实现营收5亿元；2030年计划实现年出货30万台、营收100亿元，其中海外收入占比超35%。

key_facts.fact: IDC forecasts China's quadruped robot market will exceed $700 million in 2026, doubling year-over-year. Zhiyuan Kutuo projects the broader ecosystem (including upstream, hardware add-ons, software, and services) will reach ¥100 billion by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: IDC预测，2026年中国四足机器人市场规模将超7亿美元，同比增长翻倍。智元酷拓则提出了更为乐观的千亿市场预期。

key_facts.fact: The product line spans logistics, industrial inspection, security patrol, firefighting, and education. The next-gen flagship D2 Max is positioned as the industry's first L3-level all-terrain autonomous quadruped robot.
key_facts.excerpt: 下一代旗舰机型D2 Max定位为行业首个全地形L3级智驾四足机器人，可在仓库、管廊等环境稳定执行物流搬运等任务。

key_facts.fact: Unitree leads the global quadruped market with 32.4% sales share, followed by DeepRobotics at 18.9%, according to IDC data for 2024. Q1 2026 overseas orders for Zhiyuan Kutuo already reached 40%.
key_facts.excerpt: 宇树科技以32.4%的销量份额位列第一，云深处科技以18.9%的销量份额紧随其后。2026年Q1其海外订单比例已达40%。

sources.title: 智元分拆四足机器人业务 (Zhiyuan Spins Off Quadruped Robot Business)
